title: TEAM LAMP AND HIRE BAND
why: His order of 2026-10-12, make them all look better, and his answer 24, readable silhouettes first. A small lamp in the team colour now rides on the left shoulder strap of the plate carrier, so the side a body is on reads from the strap as well as the shoulders. The hire was drawn in the foe red like any pillager although he works for you; he now wears your blue and a hi-vis amber band on his gun arm, and he never glares. Both players keep the one teammate colour, as the raid text rewrite set it.
now: A team lamp rides on every shoulder strap, and your hire wears your colour and an amber armband.
